players.product: MEMS-based OCS switch (optical circuit switch manufacturer, Wuhan, China)

quarterly_data.signal: Director and general manager Hu Qianggao (2025 annual results briefing) on datacom products: 800G optical modules are in volume shipments and their share of shipments is gradually rising; 1.6T modules have batch-delivery capability and are in customer test validation, with the ramp depending on market and customer demand; the 3.2T silicon-photonics single-mode NPO module the company launched at OFC 2026 in March (which it calls the world's first) has completed full-series validation at a leading domestic CSP (not named); 3.2T and 6.4T modules are in R&D and test validation; immersion liquid-cooled optical modules have batch-delivery capability. Its OCS technology and products are at the market-development and customer-validation stage, and it is investing in R&D of co-packaged optics (CPO) optical devices and connection solutions, with mass-production timing set by customer demand. In vehicle optical communication it focuses on automotive-grade passive fiber communication devices and systems for factory-fitted volume production.

Optical chips and sourcing (2025 annual results briefing): CFO and board secretary Xiang Ming and general manager Hu Qianggao said Accelink has DFB, EML, VCSEL and silicon-photonics optical chip programmes, with mass production and self-supply of low- and mid-speed optical chips; some self-developed high-end optical chips have begun small-batch commercial use and the company is gradually raising its self-supply ratio, with technology reserves in both silicon-photonics and indium-phosphide routes. Hu said its silicon-photonics chips are self-designed with tape-out at external foundries, and chairman Huang Xuanze said its silicon-photonics chips are currently mainly purchased externally; Hu said its DSP chips for modules are purchased externally and core materials are stocked in advance according to market demand.

General manager Hu Qianggao (2025 annual results briefing): orders are currently relatively ample; overall market demand is strong and production and operations are normal; optical-module industry demand is strong on increased compute investment by the world's major cloud providers, and the company will plan capacity according to current customer demand and future market development. Chairman Huang Xuanze said it carries some strategic stock based on its demand forecast while guarding against slow-moving inventory, and that its debt-to-asset ratio remains relatively low.
